title: Care Academy Notes: Notice Given and the Prepaid Pass Late-Cancellation Fee
content:
*Care Academy — Tailwise Grooming Salon module, prepaid passes (Express Bath, Bath & Tidy, Full Groom and Spa Groom passes).*

**The rule.** The notice treatment of the pass late-cancellation fee follows the full hours of notice recorded on the cancellation — the most recently recorded cancellation on the pass with a fee remedy:

- notice of at least half (0.5) of the pass's free-cancellation notice prorates the fee basis by the share of the free-cancellation notice that was not given, that is the fee basis multiplied by the free-cancellation notice less the notice given, divided by the free-cancellation notice;
- notice of at least a quarter (0.25) but less than half of the free-cancellation notice multiplies the fee basis by 0.75;
- notice of less than a quarter of the free-cancellation notice leaves the fee basis whole.

The fee basis is the whole fee as it stands before this treatment; the notice treatment acts on it.

**Thresholds in hours by pass**

| Pass | Free-cancellation notice | Prorated (half or more) | Multiplied by 0.75 | Whole |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Express Bath Pass 3-Visit | 24 | 12 to 23 hours | 6 to 11 hours | 0 to 5 hours |
| Bath & Tidy Pass 4-Visit | 24 | 12 to 23 hours | 6 to 11 hours | 0 to 5 hours |
| Full Groom Pass 4-Visit | 24 | 12 to 23 hours | 6 to 11 hours | 0 to 5 hours |
| Full Groom Pass 6-Visit | 24 | 12 to 23 hours | 6 to 11 hours | 0 to 5 hours |
| Spa Groom Pass 6-Visit | 48 | 24 to 47 hours | 12 to 23 hours | 0 to 11 hours |

Notice is the whole number of hours recorded on the cancellation; the hours shown are whole hours.

**Q. A Full Groom Pass 4-Visit booking with a fee basis of 20.00 was cancelled with 15 hours' notice. What does the notice treatment give?**
A. 15 is at least 12, so the fee basis is prorated: 20.00 multiplied by 24 less 15, that is 9, divided by 24, gives 7.50.

**Q. The same booking cancelled with 12 hours' notice?**
A. 12 is exactly half of 24 and so is prorated: 20.00 multiplied by 12, divided by 24, gives 10.00.

**Q. With 11 hours' notice?**
A. 11 is at least 6 and less than 12: 20.00 multiplied by 0.75 gives 15.00.

**Q. With 5 hours' notice?**
A. Less than 6: the fee basis stays whole at 20.00.

**Q. A Spa Groom Pass 6-Visit booking, fee basis 25.00, cancelled with 30 hours' notice?**
A. 30 is at least 24 of the 48 hours: 25.00 multiplied by 18, divided by 48, gives 9.375 before the final rounding.
